name: Develop browser extensions and user scripts
description: Users requested the creation of browser extensions, user scripts, or content filters to automate web interactions, modify page behavior, or extract data from specific sites. The requests covered a wide range of functionalities, including enhancing search results, managing cookie profiles, scraping content, and troubleshooting manifest configurations.
